children: The EV company is moving into fleet ownership and specialised mobility, with a Rs 66.46 crore Reliance contract for electric tractors

Electric two-wheeler retailer, BikeWo Green Tech is targeting an operating fleet of around 10,000 vehicles in FY2026-27 as it expands beyond electric vehicle sales and distribution into fleet ownership, leasing and mobility services. The expansion is being supported by a preferential issue through warrants worth more than Rs 76 crore.

The company has termed the new phase ‘BikeWo Ascend’, with plans spanning last-mile, mid-mile and long-distance transportation, enterprise mobility, specialised fleet applications and technology-enabled logistics.
Reliance Contract Adds To Fleet Plans

As part of the expansion, BikeWo has entered into contracts with Reliance Industries’ Bio Energy Division for the hiring and deployment of specialised electric tractors. The contracts have an estimated aggregate value of Rs 66.46 crore and are valid until July 2033.

The electric tractors will be used with specialised loader, catcher and grabber applications, along with driver and vehicle-operation services. The deployment takes BikeWo’s electric mobility operations into bio-energy and biomass-handling applications.
The company plans to combine vehicle assets with leasing, operating partnerships, lifecycle support and technology-enabled logistics as it expands its fleet.
From EV Retail To Fleet Operations
BikeWo started as a multi-brand electric two-wheeler retailer in Telangana in 2016 and moved into fleet operations in 2025. It listed on NSE Emerge in September 2024 after raising Rs 24.09 crore.
For the financial year ended March 2026, the company reported consolidated revenue of Rs 54.49 crore, up 132 per cent, while net profit rose to Rs 4.50 crore from Rs 0.88 crore in the previous year.

BikeWo has also appointed Sumanth Badiga to its Advisory Board. The company said its wider strategy will focus on building the assets, technology and operating capabilities needed to serve different mobility requirements.
